instruction: Tulis Dockerfile multi-stage untuk app Node.js
output:
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM node:20 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.npm npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:20-alpine
USER node
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```
Build (`npm ci` cache-mount) terpisah dari runtime (alpine + `USER node` + prod deps sahaja). `COPY --from` bawa hasil binaan; HEALTHCHECK memandu `depends_on: service_healthy`.

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.12-slim
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
USER nobody
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["gunicorn", "app:app", "-b", "0.0.0.0:8000"]
```
Slim base, no-write bytecode, unbuffered logs, `--no-cache-dir` keeps layers lean, non-root `nobody`. Exec-form CMD so signals reach gunicorn directly.

instruction: Tulis Dockerfile nginx untuk fail statik
output:
```dockerfile
FROM nginx:alpine
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY dist/ /usr/share/nginx/html/
EXPOSE 80
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD wget -qO- http://localhost/ || exit 1
```
Alpine + config ganti + aset statik — tiada toolchain dalam image akhir. `try_files $uri /index.html` dalam config untuk SPA routing.

```yaml
services:
  web:
    build: .
    ports: ["8080:3000"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:secret@db:5432/app
      REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379
    depends_on:
      db: {condition: service_healthy}
    restart: unless-stopped
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db_pass
    secrets: [db_pass]
    healthcheck: {test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready"], interval: 10s}
  cache:
    image: redis:7-alpine
secrets:
  db_pass: {file: ./db_pass.txt}
volumes:
  pgdata:
```
Kata laluan via `secrets:` (fail, bukan env), `depends_on` pada kesihatan sebenar, volum bernama untuk data. `.env` tidak dikomit.

```
node_modules
.git
*.log
.env
coverage/
dist/
.DS_Store
```
Konteks kecil = build pantas + cache stabil (fail diabaikan tidak rosakkan cache). Semak dengan `docker build` — konteks yang dihantar dipapar dalam output.

instruction: Tulis skrip backup dan restore volum docker
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
VOL=${1:?volume} 
BACKUP="/backup/${VOL}-$(date +%F).tgz"
docker run --rm --volumes-from app -v /backup:/b ubuntu \
  tar czf "/b/$(basename "$BACKUP")" /data
echo "backup: $BACKUP"
# restore:
# docker run --rm --volumes-from app -v /backup:/b ubuntu \
#   tar xzf /b/nama.tgz -C /
```
Arkib volum tanpa sentuh kontena app. Restore strim songsang. Backup berasas commit kehilangan volum — jangan sesekali.

instruction: Tulis skrip bersih cakera docker selamat
output:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
docker system df
docker container prune -f
 docker image prune -f
 docker network prune -f
# BAHAYA: tambah -a --volumes hanya dengan pengesahan
docker system df
```
`df` sebelum/selepas sebagai bukti. `volume prune` memadam data bernama — paling bahaya, jangan skrip buta. `-a` buang semua image tidak bertag.

instruction: Tulis setup private registry dan push
output:
```bash
docker run -d -p 5000:5000 --restart unless-stopped --name reg registry:2
docker tag app:1.0 localhost:5000/app:1.0
docker push localhost:5000/app:1.0
docker pull localhost:5000/app:1.0
```
Registry tempatan untuk CI/air-gapped. Luar localhost: TLS + auth dahulu. Pin digest (`@sha256:`) untuk bekalan selamat.

instruction: Tulis deploy swarm 3 replika dengan rollback
output:
```bash
docker swarm init --advertise-addr 192.168.1.10
docker service create --name web --replicas 3 -p 80:80 \
  --update-delay 10s --update-failure-action rollback \
  registry/app:2.0
docker service ls
docker service ps web
```
Update bergolek dengan sela; gagal → undur automatik ke spec lepas. Kuorum ganjil (3/5) untuk Raft; semak `docker service inspect` sebelum salahkan app.

instruction: How do I debug a crashing container?
output:
```bash
docker ps -a                          # exit code di sini
 docker logs --tail 100 web            # mesej terakhir
 docker inspect -f '{{.State}}' web    # OOMKilled? Error?
 docker events --since 1h --filter container=web
```
Baca kod keluar dahulu: 125 daemon, 137 OOM, 139 segfault, 143 SIGTERM. `OOMKilled: true` = had memori, bukan pepijat app — naikkan `--memory` atau betulkan bocor.

instruction: Tulis CI build multi-arch dan push
output:
```yaml
# .github/workflows/image.yml
- uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
- uses: docker/login-action@v3
  with: {registry: ghcr.io, username: x, password: ${{ secrets.TOKEN }}}
- run: |
    docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
      -t ghcr.io/org/app:${{ github.sha }} --push .
```
Tag dengan SHA (bukan latest terapung), multi-arch untuk Apple Silicon + server, push hanya selepas build lulus. Cache mounts + gha cache untuk kelajuan.

instruction: Tulis healthcheck compose untuk API dan DB
output:
```yaml
services:
  api:
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
  db:
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U app"]
      interval: 10s
```
`start_period` beri masa boot (elak bunuh semasa mula). Array exec-form (tiada shell) lebih tepat dari `CMD-SHELL` bila boleh.

instruction: Bagaimana kecilkan image Node dari 1GB ke 100MB?
output: 1. Multi-stage: build atas `node:20`, runtime `node:20-alpine`. 2. `npm ci --omit=dev` (bukan install). 3. `.dockerignore` (node_modules/.git). 4. Satu RUN `apt` + buang cache sama lapisan. 5. Distroless jika tiada shell diperlukan. Ukur dengan `docker images` dan `dive` setiap langkah — angka, bukan rasa.

instruction: Tulis Dockerfile dengan cache apt dan secret selamat
output:
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN rm -f /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/docker-clean
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt,sharing=locked \
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci
```
Cache apt kekal merentas build tanpa gemukkan lapisan; secret tidak dibakar ke history (lawan ARG). Perlu BuildKit + `# syntax` baris pertama.
